forward_earnings_policy.rule: At late-cycle or normalization risk, current-year peak EPS must not be capitalized alone. Build a forward-12-month proxy by calendar-weighting current-year and next-year consensus EPS, then stress it with the structured 6-18m cycle regime and only a limited short-term commodity-anchor adjustment.

short_term_anchor_policy.rule: Current/MA60 commodity strength is a near-term modifier only. It cannot override a bearish/normalizing 6-18m supply-demand regime.

601899.name: 紫金矿业
601899.rationale: 2026H1黄金和铜合计贡献集团毛利约75.5%，以黄金/铜双商品锚和跨年度Forward盈利中枢共同决定估值。

601600.name: 中国铝业
601600.rationale: 原铝板块为主要利润弹性来源，氧化铝同时是业务与成本变量；高利润阶段必须用2027供给恢复风险压测Forward盈利。

000807.name: 云铝股份
000807.rationale: 低成本水电铝与一体化优势支持相对溢价，但中东复产、库存重建和需求正常化风险意味着不能把当前高吨铝利润按11-15倍永久资本化。

scenario_rules.rule: Final cycle EPS scenario starts from calendar-weighted 2026/2027 consensus, applies structured 6-18m regime bear/base/bull factors, then applies only a capped short-term commodity/MA60 adjustment through earnings sensitivity.
